title: Red panda holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M50 52 Q55 40 58 28' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='18' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='18' rx='10' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#FF8FA3' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='14' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FFB3C1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- balloon knot -->
  <polygon points='57,30 59,30 58,32' fill='#FF8FA3'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#C1440E'/>
  <!-- chest/belly lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#E86A2A'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='48' r='16' fill='#C1440E'/>
  <!-- face white markings -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='52' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#F5E6D3'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='33,38 38,30 42,38' fill='#A83208'/>
  <polygon points='48,38 52,30 57,38' fill='#A83208'/>
  <polygon points='35,37 38,32 41,37' fill='#F5E6D3'/>
  <polygon points='49,37 52,32 55,37' fill='#F5E6D3'/>
  <!-- eye patches (dark but lit) -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='47' rx='5' ry='4.5' fill='#5C1A00'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='47' rx='5' ry='4.5' fill='#5C1A00'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#FFE8A3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#FFE8A3'/>
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='47' r='1.2' fill='#2A0A00'/>
  <circle cx='50.5' cy='47' r='1.2' fill='#2A0A00'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='53' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#3A1000'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M42 56 Q45 58 48 56' stroke='#8A3010' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='64' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#A83208' transform='rotate(-25 28 64)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='60' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#A83208' transform='rotate(20 62 60)'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='66' r='3' fill='#5C1A00'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='58' r='3' fill='#5C1A00'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='84' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#A83208'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='84' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#A83208'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='86' r='3' fill='#5C1A00'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='86' r='3' fill='#5C1A00'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='74' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#E86A2A' transform='rotate(20 66 74)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='73' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#A83208' transform='rotate(20 68 73)'/>
  <!-- ringed tail tip -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='71' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#5C1A00' transform='rotate(20 72 71)'/>
  <!-- smile cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='53' r='2' fill='#FF9E7A' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='53' r='2' fill='#FF9E7A' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
